title: Low-pressure phrase focus correction
description: Corrects the VOICE-039 listening issue where the phrase 'You don't need to change anything today' attracted unnatural emphasis.

runtime_boundary.changes_allowed: English freeform provider-facing TTS wording may use a shorter low-pressure phrase to reduce wrong emphasis.
changes_forbidden: rewriting protected campaign, compliance, handoff, hangup, or do-not-call text
